info.title: RaiGuard
info.description: Official .NET Global Tool CLI for RaiGuard opinionated Roslyn guardrails. Audits, verifies, and automatically refactors framework physics violations across solutions.

options.name: --rule
options.description:
	filter by rule ID (e.g. RAI001, RAI011)
-g, --group		filter by rule group set (OsLib, CloudSync, JsonPit, CliCommand, RaiMedia, Formatting)
--groups		list all rule groups (sets) with their member RAIxxx rules

options.name: --json
options.description:
	output diagnostics in JSON format
--dry-run		simulate code fixes without modifying source files on disk
